steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen, which starts with an Auction stage.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Verify the initial project has exactly one Auction stage.
Open the plus-button Add Stages menu beside the stage tabs.
Verify Technical Stage is offered for addition.
Add the Technical Stage from the open menu.
Verify the resulting tabs are Technical Stage first and Auction second.
